author: J.W. COOKE Keys
title: Harbor comes alive Sunday for third leg of Schooner Wharf Wrecker's Cup - NewsBreak
text:
By J.W. COOKE Keys ,
5 hours ago The Wrecker’s Cup Race Series returns to Key West Harbor Sunday with the third race of the 2026 season, promising another day of spirited competition and seaside celebration. The popular regatta draws both local sailors and visiting yachts, all competing in a lively event inspired by Key West’s 1800s-era wrecking tradition.
A wide variety of vessels will take part, from 16-foot Hobie Cats and sloops of varying sizes to recreational yachts, liveaboard boats, and majestic schooners that add a touch of old-world charm to the harbor. Organizers emphasize that the race is as much about fun and community as it is about competition, giving sailors a chance to meet fellow enthusiasts and enjoy the island’s storied maritime culture.
A captains’ meeting is scheduled for Saturday at 7 p.m. in the Schooner Wharf Sail Loft, where participants will be treated to complimentary Pusser’s Rum Punch and hors d’oeuvres from the Schooner Wharf Galley. Entry for each vessel is $40, which includes eligibility for the post-race awards ceremony. Winners and crews can enjoy up to four BBQ pork dinners, and the day’s race will be videotaped for participants to see themselves on the big screen during the awards celebration.
Organizers encourage visiting sailors to join the local “Wrecker’s Fleet” for a day on the water, camaraderie, and a festive celebration at Schooner Wharf Bar afterward. For more information, participants can visit the race website www.SchoonerWharf.com/25wreckersrace3.htm or call the Schooner Wharf Bar for details.
